statement: Linux hid-playstation aborts DualSense probe if feature 0x05 calibration GET_REPORT fails, but if the report is returned with zero gyro sensitivity denominator, it substitutes per-axis bias=0, numerator=DS_GYRO_RANGE, denominator=S16_MAX; for zero accelerometer span, bias=0, numerator=DS_ACC_RANGE, denominator=S16_MAX. It does not blindly accept divide-by-zero calibration.

applicability.revision: source revisions: Linux 4056b3c, SDL 535d80b/829a65d, HHD adbd50f and community pinned commits; physical firmware unknown
applicability.scope: hid-playstation.c 1023-1147 and probe 1816-1820; distinct from SDL's non-fatal short-read fallback.
